description: Answers 'when is this earnings report, or the next CPI / payrolls / FOMC release?' Give kind earnings or macro, plus start and end dates. Returns events clipped to as_of, up to 5,000 rows per page. kind=macro returns market-moving releases by default (CPI, payrolls, GDP, PCE, retail sales, claims, ISM and more); pass all_releases=true for every data release. Earnings cover US company report dates; macro covers the full release calendar.

all_releases.description: kind=macro only: true returns every data release (hundreds a week); default returns market-moving releases (CPI, payrolls, GDP, PCE, retail sales, claims, ISM ...).

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: get_events
title: Get events
